answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. The quill of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The spiral is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ferrous.
